summary: Sends a chat reply back for rewriting when it offers to buy something, such as asking whether to grab the domain.
doc: This Stop hook blocks a reply that offers to buy something, including "I'll buy it", "want me to grab the domain" and "should I register it". It also blocks similar first-person offers and offers to approve the spend. A price and availability report passes. A sentence that says the user buys or that the model will not buy also passes. The hook pairs with no-purchase, which covers the tool call itself. Put an offer in a fenced code block, an inline backtick span, a '>' blockquote or a double-quoted span of twelve characters or more to quote it on purpose. The hook blocks at most once per turn.
